basic_info.description: Welcome to Vida - a sleek, modern residence nestled on a quiet street in the heart of San Francisco's Inner Mission District. This 1 bed, 1 bath condo offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and urban convenience in one of the city's most dynamic neighborhoods. Inside, you'll find an open-concept living space bathed in natural light, featuring engineer wood flooring, striking concrete ceilings, bay windows, and a private balcony with scenic city views. The gourmet kitchen is outfitted with modern European cabinetry, high end appliances including a Liebherr refrigerator and a full suite of premium Bosch appliances, and in-unit washer and dryer designed to elevate your everyday living experience. The bedroom offers city views, creating a bright and relaxing retreat that complements the home's airy atmosphere. The spacious, modern bathroom features a frameless glass shower door and sleek finishes, creating a clean and contemporary feel. Enjoy amenities including a Rooftop deck with BBQ and sweeping views, Fitness center, Bike storage, Stylish lobby and resident common areas, and Front Desk Attendant. Step outside and enjoy immediate access to some of the city's best restaurants and nightlife. With easy access to BART, Muni, Shuttles, 101/280, commuting is simple and efficient.
